input.question: What sport does Cameron Murray play?

documents.text: up 14,500 total yards as a rusher and a passer and scored 186 combined touchdowns in his three seasons leading the Allen HS basketball team... named Mr. Texas Basketball Player of the Year in 2014 by Dave Campbell’s Texas Basketball magazine... named National Player of the Year by Parade, Gatorade, MaxPreps, and the USA Today... His father, Kevin, lettered at Texas A&M from 1983-86 and finished his career holding virtually every season and career passing record. The elder Murray was inducted into the A&M Hall of Fame in 2005.
